exact_statement: For every actual nonconstant Boolean sign f on the n-bit uniform cube, n>=2, with H in bits and phi=min over nonempty proper physical blocks A with I_A>0 of (H(f)-E H(f_a))/I_A, phi(f)<=H(f)/(I(f)-min_i Inf_i(f))<=n(H(f)/I(f))/(n-1). If M_n=max H/I over all nonconstant n-bit functions and K_desc(n)=max phi over the same finite domain, then M_n<=K_desc(n)<=n M_n/(n-1). Therefore lim_n K_desc(n)=sup_n M_n=C_* in the extended real sense, and bounded universal proper-block descent is equivalent in finiteness to FEI. No all-dimensional optimizer, independent uniform bound, or paid entropy estimate is asserted.

exact_statement: For the full family of 1150 unordered read-once NAND formula trees with no unary internal gate, arbitrary arity>=2, and6..9 disjoint literal leaves, exact orbit certificates cover117240 proper-block orbits representing470340 labelled blocks and certify phi<227/50 for every member. Dimensionwise maxima are certified by the rational intervals in out/AGGREGATE_CERTIFICATES.json. The eight-bit three-level complete binary NAND tree has exactly phi/(H/I)=8/7. Seven explicitly defined Hod corrected six/eight-bit seed and fresh NAND-extension controls also have phi<227/50. These are finite family results, not all Boolean functions, not all recursive lower-bound compositions, and not a universal block payment.
